extras: Desktop only. Mobile is not supported. Properties come from frontmatter; inline key:: value properties are not read.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that turns deck notes into Slides: an immersive, editable (Live Preview) "one screen = one card" view
problem: Standard note viewing does not provide an immersive, presentation-style view for structured deck notes.
summary: Turns deck notes into an immersive, editable card view with PPT-style navigation, driven by a single frontmatter property.
